The '''Scales of Office''' is a silver medallion in the form of a set of balance scales. These, along with a set of real scales, represent the office of Mayor in [[Emond's Field]].

==Bran al'Vere's==
[[Bran al'Vere]] typically wears this for dealing with merchants, for festivals and for weddings. He is wearing this during the day of [[Winternight]].{{ref/book|1|1}}
